description: Threshold screen over up to 10 caller-supplied tickers (extras named in `dropped`) on latest-year SEC EDGAR XBRL fundamentals. Optional criteria: min_revenue, min_free_cash_flow, min_ebit_margin_pct, min_gross_margin_pct, max_debt_to_assets_pct, min_current_ratio, min_net_income (whole USD; *_pct as percentage numbers). Each result carries verdict: pass, fail (a reported value misses a threshold, in failed_criteria) or unknown (a metric not filed for the latest year, in unevaluated_criteria; unknown is not a fail). Not a universe screen; a fundamentals filter, NOT a buy signal. Source: SEC EDGAR company-facts XBRL.

tickers.description: 2-10 candidate ticker symbols to screen (hard-capped at 10).
